# Security policy

## Report privately

Email denys.ziuziuk.w@gmail.com with "Nuvo security" in the subject. Do not open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability.

Include the version (Settings, About), your Linux distribution, the steps to reproduce, and what an attacker gains. I reply within a week. I will tell you when a fix ships and credit you if you want.

## In scope

- The Rust daemon `nuvo-core`: its local API, authentication, the encrypted database, the encrypted audio cache, the recovery phrase.
- The Electron app: the preload bridge, window and permission policy, content security policy, link and file handling, the custom CSS and theme file checks.
- Anything that leaks the master key, library contents or listening history to another user, process or host.

## Out of scope

- Attacks that need an already compromised account or root on the machine. Nuvo cannot protect an unlocked keyring from code running as you.
- Weaknesses in YouTube, SoundCloud, yt-dlp, ffmpeg or other services Nuvo talks to. Report those to their maintainers.
- Denial of service by a user against their own machine.
- Missing hardening that has no demonstrated effect.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes.
